name: Why is the shower waterproofing stage so critical during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Why is the shower waterproofing stage so critical during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waterproofing is the most critical phase of a bathroom remodel because tile and grout are water-resistant, not completely waterproof. Behind every tiled shower or tub surround, a continuous waterproofing membrane must be applied over cementitious backer board to prevent moisture from reaching drywall, insulation, and framing. Contractors must seal corner seams, screw penetrations, and pipe cutouts, and properly integrate the shower pan liner with the drain flange. Skipping or rushing these barrier steps leads to slow framing rot, mold development, and costly structural repairs down the road.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile and grout are permeable; a proper waterproofing membrane behind the tile prevents moisture from leaking into wall studs and subfloors.
